XXL on Instagram: "T.I. will retire from rap after the release of his upcoming album, Kill the King.

The revered Atlanta rapper shared the news on Sunday (Feb. 1) at the 2026 Grammy Awards. “‘Let Em Know,’ produced by Pharrell,” he told Entertainment Tonight. “My first single off my final album. I’ma be done.”

He elaborated on why it’s time to hang up the mic. “I think I have many gifts that God has given me, man, that I could spend some more time and attention on and spend more time at home with my family and grandchildren,” T.I. added. “It’s plenty stuff to do.”

Tip dropped the new track “Let Em Know” last month to rave reviews. This marks the first music release he’s put out in recent months since he began following his passion for stand-up comedy, which he’s done for the last few years. The MC even unleashed a new comedy special called Cheaper Than Therapy last December.

This isn’t the first time T.I. has talked about retiring. In a 2023 Off The Porch interview with Dirty Glove Bastard, he said during his come up over 20 years ago, that it was an “actual achievement to put out an album” and feels there’s no longer a “ceremony around it.” He delivered his debut album, I’m Serious, in 2001.

Do you think T.I. should retire?"
